Cynthia Cohen (Founder at Nuchu | Raising SEIS)
🎉 Excited to share that Nuchu is now live on FUNC!

Nuchu was born from a personal challenge. After being diagnosed with IBS, I struggled to find gummies that supported my health without the added sugars or sweeteners.

That experience inspired me to create Nuchu: a range of gut-friendly gummy supplements designed to make wellness simple, enjoyable, and more accessible for people who want to support their health without compromise.

We're thrilled to be joining the FUNC platform and reaching a wider community of health-conscious consumers.

This is just the beginning.

👉 Discover Nuchu on FUNC: https://funcworld.com/
